verses.en: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.pt: Na minha angústia clamei ao Senhor, e ele me ouviu.
verses.en_web: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> In my trouble my cry went up to the Lord, and he gave me an answer.

verses.en: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.pt: Senhor, livra-me dos lábios mentirosos e da língua enganadora.
verses.en_web: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, be the saviour of my soul from false lips, and from the tongue of deceit.

verses.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.pt: Que te será dado, ou que te será acrescentado, língua enganadora?
verses.en_web: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
verses.en_bbe: What punishment will he give you? what more will he do to you, you false tongue?

verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.pt: Flechas agudas do valente, com brasas vivas de zimbro!
verses.en_web: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.en_bbe: Sharp arrows of the strong, and burning fire.

verses.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.pt: Ai de mim, que peregrino em Meseque, e habito entre as tendas de Quedar!
verses.en_web: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.en_bbe: Sorrow is mine because I am strange in Meshech, and living in the tents of Kedar.

verses.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.pt: Há muito que eu habito com aqueles que odeiam a paz.
verses.en_web: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
verses.en_bbe: My soul has long been living with the haters of peace.

verses.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.pt: Eu sou pela paz; mas quando falo, eles são pela guerra.
verses.en_web: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.en_bbe: I am for peace: but when I say so, they are for war.
